blurb: The mission of Malagash Bible Camp is to glorify God by promoting the gospel of Jesus Christ, by operating a retreat and summer camp ministry. For more then 50 years, MBC has welcomed campers to experience a summer of making friends, growing in faith, and experiencing God’s truth for today’s world.
